management_remarks: In Q4 FY26, ICICI Bank culminated the fiscal year with full-year PAT of Rs 49,540 Crore, Net Interest Margin at 4.30%, and Consolidated ROE of 17.50%. Total deposits crossed Rs 18.02 Lakh Crore while Advances reached Rs 15.18 Lakh Crore, supported by industry-best digital engagement and branch productivity. The Board declared a dividend of Rs 13.50 per share, supported by Tier-1 capital adequacy of 16.25% and pristine balance sheet quality.
analyst_qa: Looking ahead to FY27, global geopolitical uncertainty and volatile interest rate expectations warrant a cautious and calibrated credit growth posture. Unsecured retail growth continues moderating toward core mortgage and business banking rates as we guard against potential retail credit headwinds. While ROE remains healthy, further leverage expansion is challenging and subject to evolving RBI capital and liquidity guidelines.
